_comment: Verified display-number to bank-id map for SHOSMED_LF3_Chemistry_Batch5_Review.txt,
implemented 17 November 2026.
The review supplies no bank ids and no original stems: it names each item by topic
and supplies the full 60-letter key block. Verification therefore ran as follows,
all against the stored records BEFORE any edit:
1. Every 60-record window in the 485-record chemistry bank was tested against the
review's key block CBAACDCBCC BBBBBBBCCB CBBCBACBBB CBBBBABDBB BBCBCBBBBC
CCBCBBBBBB. Exactly ONE window matches: chem-242 .. chem-301. No other window
in the bank reproduces the block.
2. Each item's stored key was compared individually with the review's letter for
that display number: 60 of 60 agree, and the derived A/B/C/D tally is
A=4 B=37 C=17 D=2, exactly the review's tally.
3. Each item's FULL stem text, and the full stem plus all four option texts, were
tested for uniqueness across the whole chemistry bank. Every one of the 60 is
unique on the stem alone, so no two candidates could be confused.
4. Each display number's topic was read against the review's own section title
(Q1 ethyne hybridization, Q2 hydration of propyne, ... Q60 one chiral center)
and against the specific defects the review reports for it, for example Q14's
A and D both naming the meta isomer and Q19's B overlapping C on timing.
Contiguity is therefore a RESULT of the verification, not an assumption.
No id in this pack appears in chemistry batches 1, 2, 3 or 4 (239 ids), so all 60
displays are newly reviewed unique ids.
Independently confirmed stored inventories, all matching the review:
57 three-point blocks in Q1-Q57, drawn from only THREE stock blocks of three
lines (x30, x20, x7 = 57 items); individual five-point blocks in Q58, Q59, Q60;
186 points stored in total, so the total does not change in this pass.
0 Bottom Lines and 0 tables stored, and none added.
All 60 keyed headings are LETTERED, and 240 of 240 headings agree with their own
option text.

Every item's main explanation is a SINGLE paragraph; there is no

anywhere
in the pack, so the supplied multi-sentence replacements stay in one paragraph.
No HTML entities are stored (< > & all zero); 71 <sub> tags, no <sup>.
Q29 (chem-270) and Q36 (chem-277) each end with a pre-existing empty
, preserved byte-for-byte.
